question: The golden quadrilateral super highways connect Delhi, ________, Chennai, and Mumbai.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kolkata.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Golden Quadrilateral **is a network of highways connecting the **major cities** of India.
 
• It is the** largest highway project **in India and was launched in **2001.**
 
• The four major cities connected by the Golden Quadrilateral are **Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, and Mumbai.**
 
• These cities are located in different parts of India and are important centers of** commerce, trade, and industry.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The option 1, Kolkata, is the **correct answer **as it is one of the four cities connected by the Golden Quadrilateral.

 
 
• Kolkata is the capital of **West Bengal **and is an important **port city **in eastern India.
 
 
 
• Option 2, Nagpur, is **not **a part of the Golden Quadrilateral.
 
 
• However, it is an important city in central India and is known for its **orange cultivation** and **manufacturing industries.**
 
 
 
• Option 3, Jhansi, is also** not** a part of the Golden Quadrilateral.
 
 
• It is a city in **Uttar Pradesh** and is known for its **historical significance** as it was a stronghold of the **Maratha empire.**
 
 
 
• Option 4, Dehradun, is **not** a part of the Golden Quadrilateral.
 
 
• It is the **capital of Uttarakhand** and is known for its scenic beauty and as a **center of education.**
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1, Kolkata, as it is one of the four cities connected by the Golden Quadrilateral.
